results.description:
What if your Bible was missing many books of sacred scripture?

The Complete Ethiopian Bible brings to life the ancient 88-book canon preserved by the Ethiopian Orthodox Church—a collection that includes all the traditional scriptures plus apocryphal, deuterocanonical, and mystical writings lost to most of the world.

This audiobook offers a powerful encounter with one of the oldest and most comprehensive Bibles in history, newly translated into clear, modern language.

What you’ll discover inside:

•The Entire Old Testament in its Ethiopian Form – With added chapters and expanded passages not found in Western canons •The Books of Enoch, Jubilees & Meqabyan – Ancient writings on angels, time cycles, cosmic battles, and redemption •Forgotten Deuterocanonical Books – Including Sirach, Baruch, Wisdom, Tobit, and Judith •An Expanded New Testament – Featuring eight additional texts, including Sinodos and Ethiopic Didascalia •Modern, Accessible Language – Clear translations that honor the spiritual gravity of each book

Whether you’re a Bible scholar, theologian, or spiritual explorer, this audiobook will broaden your understanding of divine scripture.

Experience the Bible as it was preserved in the highlands of Ethiopia—and uncover a world of sacred truth hidden in plain sight.
